body: The *765 Guide is a brochure created by the Women's Secretariat of Mexico City to provide guidance in cases of violence against women
Its target audience is witnesses and victims of violence, so its content must be clear and easy to understand
While reading it, I found out that it contains links to web pages, phone numbers, and addresses, which could be better used in a digital format

body.caption: Printed elements in the trifold brochure that could be interactive

body: Seeing this, I proposed converting the *765 Guide into a web page
Deepened my analysis with Rob Waller's evaluation criteria, which provides strategies for optimizing and transforming documents
Found out that the guide makes great use of pictograms and steps, but some are confusing or redundant

body.caption: Use of different types of pictograms, some unrelated to the text

body: Redesigned the information for faster scanning (larger font and F-shaped reading pattern) and better structural clarity (concise headlines and sections)

body.caption: Headlines and sections after, being direct and clear for each case

body: Improved the instructions by turning them into direct sentences that start with a verb, so they are understood more quickly
Optimized navigation and accessibility by turning elements that pointed to external resources or actions outside the guide, such as phone calls, into links

body.caption: Buttons leading to the official pages and other page elements

body: Increased clarity about the differences between the institutions that can be approached, so that users can choose the one best suited to their case

body.caption: Added an explanation of the different recommended institutions

body: Strengthened visual consistency by redesigning pictograms based on the alphabet of the page's typeface
Optimized visual communication by designing new pictograms that improved the match between the graphic elements and the information presented
Obtained favorable responses about the understanding of the guide and its pictograms by testing it with men and women aged 20 to 60
The guide still needs to be tested with people who have been in situations of violence and with experts on the subject
Information design must prioritize its most important function, in this case its use in emergencies
Graphic resources must be consistent and coherent with the information they represent
